The personal site at
[sites.google.com/site/andrewsteinphd](https://sites.google.com/site/andrewsteinphd/home)
and this site should be one site, with nothing dropped without a recorded
decision to drop it. The migration has been specified and not started.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). What moves, where it lands, what
  happens to the old URLs, and in what order to do it. Its **In brief** section
  is one screen and says what the rest argues. The content inventory in Section
  5 is empty and filling it is the first phase of the work.
